app.name: Balatro Wii
app.long_description:
Balatro Wii is an unofficial homebrew port of the hit poker-inspired roguelike deckbuilder for the Nintendo Wii console. Combine valid poker hands with unique Joker cards to create powerful synergies and big wins, now running on classic hardware.
Credits: Original Game: LocalThunk Wii Port: ThatSkywalkerAbood
